column3: Close to the Hebrew; הָרְפָאִים (“the shades, Rephaim”) is rendered “The dead.”
Close to the Hebrew; the place name לָאֲבַדּוֹן (“Abaddon”) is translated “Destruction.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a limit he has drawn as a circle” is rendered “He drew a circular horizon.”
Close to the Hebrew; the name רָהַב (“Rahab”) is rendered “the storm.”
NKJV renders בְּרוּחוֹ (“his wind/breath”) as “By His Spirit,” and “clearness” as “He adorned.”
